title: Founded a bottled-water company in Hangzhou in 1996 that became
statement: Founded a bottled-water company in Hangzhou in 1996 that became Nongfu Spring.
outcome: Nongfu Spring grew into China's largest bottled-water maker and one of the world's largest beverage companies; Zhong's net worth reached an estimated $77.5 billion as of 2025.

title: Was re-elected/re-appointed as chairman of Nongfu Spring's Ninth
statement: Was re-elected/re-appointed as chairman of Nongfu Spring's Ninth Board of Directors, effective May 19, 2026, for a three-year term.
outcome: Zhong's chairmanship was formally renewed through the Ninth Board's three-year term beginning May 19, 2026.
